A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same DiagramQG dataset and HKI-DDCQG framework. Their main text, equations, Tables 1–7, Figures 1–9 and complete appendices are readable and support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v4 reports original evaluations on DiagramQG and four natural-image datasets, component ablations, parameter sensitivity results and generated-question examples (Tables 2–6; Figures 6–9).

after.justification: v5 retains these original benchmark evaluations, ablations, sensitivity results and qualitative examples, including the appendix case studies.

M1.justification: Section 4 retains the same HierKnowExtract, KnowSelect and KnowFusionQG pipeline, including trainable CLIP/T5, frozen VLM knowledge extraction, patch selection and gated multimodal fusion.

E1.justification: Both evaluate on DiagramQG, VQG-COCO, OK-VQA, A-OKVQA and K-VQG with the same task requirements and domain coverage. Newly cited benchmarks are not added to the evaluations.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical within Tables 2–4, including text-only VLM controls and fine-tuned baselines. InternVL2.5's citation changes from Wang et al., 2025 to 2025b without changing the evaluated method.

E3.justification: Reported splits, model configurations, three-reference-question prompting, metrics and training settings are unchanged. The conflicting specifications in Section 5.1 and Appendix A, including 10 versus 20 training epochs, persist in both versions.

E4.justification: Tables 5–6 retain the same component ablations and sensitivity tests over pyramid layers and selected knowledge sentences. Figure 6's comparison with GPT-4o and Appendix D's three failure-case analyses are also unchanged.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run or seed counts, result variances, confidence intervals or formal significance tests. The point-estimate reporting practice is unchanged.

E6.justification: Reported values in Tables 1–7 and generated-question examples in Figures 6–9 are unchanged. For example, Table 2's HKI-DDCQG(Q-7B, T5-L) retains BLEU-4 44.85, METEOR 50.73 and CIDEr 4.04.

T1.justification: The conditional task definition and Equations (1)–(7), covering patch construction, selection, knowledge attention and multimodal fusion, are mathematically unchanged. Neither version contains additional theorems or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list and conclusion retain the same dataset/task novelty, framework and performance/generalization claims. The added citations do not change their scientific scope.

C2.justification: Interpretations of knowledge selection, VLM contributions and parameter sensitivity are retained. The limitations concerning absent distractor options and long-tail courses, Appendix C's overlapping-diagram discussion and Appendix D's failure explanations are unchanged.

D1.justification: Implementation, hyperparameter and hardware details in Section 5.1 and Appendix A, baseline prompting, and dataset/annotator disclosures are retained. The ethical statement still promises future dataset release; no new code or data access information is supplied.

R1.justification: v5 adds citations and references for PhysReason, alignment-guided self-supervised diagram question answering, EvoChart and VProChart in the introduction and Section 2.2. This modestly expands literature coverage without substantially redefining the paper's positioning.

P1.justification: v5 expands affiliations and contact details, adds a corresponding-author footnote and Section 7 Acknowledgements, lightly rewrites Section 2.2 and renumbers subsequent sections. Most scientific and appendix prose remains unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures, table structures and captions are retained. Table 7 moves from page 13 to page 15, while the revised author block and added acknowledgements and references reflow the text and appendix placement. These are limited layout adjustments.

improvement.justification: v5 modestly improves bibliographic and funding-disclosure completeness through four citations, acknowledgements and expanded author information. The scientific exposition, evidence and reproducibility remain essentially unchanged, including the conflicting training specifications in Section 5.1 and Appendix A. These editorial additions produce no meaningful net change in overall paper quality.
